subject: Debit note for INV-2526-01310
body:
Dear Orion Logistics Private Limited team,

We reviewed invoice INV-2526-01310 dated 10 Sep 2025 and found an error. The party is in another state (state code 33), so the supply should carry IGST, but the invoice charges CGST plus SGST.

We are issuing a debit note for Rs 31,666 and will send the corrected invoice. Please adjust your records.

Regards,
Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
